Dying now rewinds the run rather than freezing it.

Shop cards turn over: tap to read an upgrade, hold to buy it.

Music and sound effects can be silenced separately.

TB-26 explains some mechanics early on, reports what each run earned, and hints when you lose at 10 minutes.

Endless mode no longer flattens out: asteroid health keeps climbing, so runs end.

Locked pilots show what the bar knows instead of a "?".

Fixes a crash on death on Android 9, and runs that finished without paying out.
